texto: Essential vocabulary for ordering food and drink: «ข้าว» (khâao, rice or food in general), «น้ำ» (náam, water or drink), «ไก่» (kài, chicken) and «เผ็ด» (phèt, spicy). In a restaurant or street stall in Thailand, «ขอ...» (khɔ̌ɔ...) is the standard, polite phrase for asking for something: «ขอน้ำครับ» (Water, please). To order dishes with combined ingredients, «กับ» (kàp, with) is used: «ขอข้าวกับไก่ค่ะ» (Rice with chicken, please). To specify the level of spiciness: «ไม่เผ็ด» (not spicy) or «เผ็ดน้อย» (a little spicy).
